newsitem.title: USA: Vandals burn Florida veteran's Memorial Day flag.
newsitem.headline: Vandals burn Florida veteran's Memorial Day flag.

text.p: Vandals set fire to the Stars and Stripes that a Vietnam War veteran had hung outside his home for Memorial Day.
Bob Gagnon said he hoisted the flag on Saturday. Neighbourhood kids jeered at him when he asked them why they were not flying a flag too, he said in Monday's Fort Lauderdale Sun-Sentinel.
Shortly afterward his flag was set ablaze.
"These flags are flown to honour all the people who died. They're heroes," said Gagnon's neighbour John Zavatski, a Marine who fought in the Pacific in World War II.
"But this younger generation doesn't understand that. I don't understand the stupidity behind this," he said.
